newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Cocobank Q1 net up 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Cocobank Q1 net up 27 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' United Coconut Planters Bank (Cocobank) said on Tuesday its net income rose 27 percent in the first quarter of the year to 692 million pesos from 544 million pesos posted in the same period a year ago.
Total loans expanded by 14 percent to 50.672 billion pesos against 44.499 billion pesos as of March 31 last year.
Return on equity improved to 25.4 percent from 24.1 percent last year, the bank said in a statement.

Cocobank is one of the Philippines' top 10 banks with most of its shares sequestered by the government on suspicion that they are owned by a close business associate of late former president Ferdinand Marcos.
